openings.claim: Make each earliest-supported-boundary certificate retractable through its cited support set. Manifest order organizes comparisons; the anomalous timestamp leaves execution order unresolved.
openings.delta: Change the evidence carrier to a script-indexed ledger connecting each claim to required record identifiers. Store dictionary-compatible boundary comparisons as equal, unequal, absent or incomparable. On record removal, invalidate dependent claims and recompute their supported stage or unresolved interval from remaining evidence.
openings.prediction: Against timestamp-sorted first-mismatch reporting, export will not be declared chronologically earliest solely from its timestamp. Missing transform evidence should widen localization unless surviving comparable records bridge the gap. Retraction should prevent definite claims retaining removed support; this is unmeasured.
openings.probe: Compare variants on the supplied disjoint three-pair subsets. Log every manual inspection, including reinspection, within twelve per pair. Perform the specified random transform-record removal during final review; freeze revised outputs before opening the two sealed answer sheets. In the additional twenty minutes, compare supported localization, interval containment and inspection totals. Different subsets confound performance attribution.
assumptions: For all six pairs, emit record references and a next check using a supplied upstream output or downstream input beside the gap. If unavailable within the remaining budget, name the evidence or capacity limit.

Definite stage claims require cited comparable records, matching inputs, differing outputs and adequate earlier-boundary evidence. Recorded equality does not exclude hidden divergence and reconvergence.

Dictionary-confirmed boundary identity is required to bridge missing output evidence with downstream input. Manifest entries, absent records and blank warnings prove neither execution nor success; explanations remain separate.

Ambiguous boundaries, missing bracketing evidence, unresolved order or exhausting twelve inspections or sixty analyst minutes defeat localization. Widen uncertainty accordingly. The stop cap does not establish informative feasibility; timely completion remains unmeasured.

assessment: Hypothetical workflow probe; no deployment, measured accuracy or observed world effects.
